thread:
maria-ACME: hi, our org admin (me) can't invite anybody to project 'staging-backend' — console shows 403 and 'permission denied' when clicking Add Member. Happening since 09:15 PDT. Can you help? We're blocked :pray:

alex-support: sorry about that — can you paste the full error or a screenshot? Is this for org or project level invite?

maria-ACME: project level. Screenshot attached (not in thread). Console shows toast '403: forbidden - role assignment blocked'. Also tried API with `POST /v1/projects/proj-stg-11/members` and got 403.

alex-support: thanks. Quick ask — what's org id and project id? any recent SSO/SCIM changes or migrations?

maria-ACME: org: org_952; project: proj-stg-11. We recently merged groups in Okta last night; SCIM sync ran at 03:00 UTC.

jordan-eng: I can take a look. Can you run `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/proj-stg-11/roles` and paste response? Also include trace id from console error if available.

maria-ACME: `curl` returns 403 with body: `{ "error": "forbidden", "detail": "write_lock: role propagation in progress" }` Trace-id: trace_8c7a2

sandra-sre: :eyes: interesting. We have a background SCIM batch job that takes a DB write-lock during merges. It looks like the job didn't clear the lock after a failed retry. I'll check the job queue.

ops-bot: Incident tracker created: INC-2026-314. Notifying infra team.

alex-support: workaround: try inviting via org owner (console > org settings > invite) or use API with `?force_propagation=true` (temporary internal flag). If you want, I can trigger a manual resync.

maria-ACME: can you trigger a manual resync? we've got 3 hires stuck.

jordan-eng: I kicked the SCIM reindex and cleared the write lock. Response: job completed, no errors. Please retry invites.

maria-ACME: re-invited one user — success! Console shows member added. Thanks!! :tada:

sandra-sre: root cause: SCIM group-merge created a long-running DB transaction that left a metadata flag `role_propagation_locked=true`. We patched the handler to clear the flag on retry failure and added a 15m TTL. Will roll out fix to prod in 30m. Postmortem will follow.

alex-support: closing for now but leaving INC-2026-314 open until patch is live. @maria-ACME I'll DM you the temporary audit logs we pulled.

maria-ACME: appreciate it, team. Please add the invite timestamps to the audit for compliance. —maria
